title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-45536)
description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the wso2am package related to the Netty network application framework. This vulnerability affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The flaw does not impact confidentiality or integrity but can cause availability issues. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 to address this issue.
